answer: Keep the agent meadow honest with a roaming census, not a gate at signup: each epoch, randomly chosen quill scribes visit a sample of agents and demand fresh proof of a real job done for a stranger. An agent's kernel, its identity root, can graft onto a new domain only after passing three such censuses in different corners of the meadow, so trust spreads slowly and leaves a trail. A duplicate cannot copy another's census record, since each proof binds to one key and one job. Sybil farms must pass fresh censuses and regraft kernels for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
